method: Theil–Sen flat-bottom baseline slopes and median caplines. One uniform scale per physical source page; independent row baselines; no individual glyph-height normalization.

regular-12-n.note: Independent baseline for the distant numeral block. Observed baseline figures anchor one rigid transform; all figures retain their source-relative positions at the same physical page scale. No individual figure height or baseline normalization.

regular-12-census-n.note: Independent baseline for the distant numeral block. Observed baseline figures anchor one rigid transform; all figures retain their source-relative positions at the same physical page scale. No individual figure height or baseline normalization.

byu-600-12-caps.method: Seven whole-setting capital serif-foot windows E/X/T/A/L; median native column bottoms atT150; Theil-Sen slope and median intercept. Round overshoots, sweeping R tail and bothS excluded. Foot windows measure baseline only; glyph shapes remain whole.
byu-600-12-caps.review: All seven windows coincide with whole capital serif feet in native EXECUTOR’S SALE; round overshoots and R tail excluded. Red baseline and blue anchor windows visually inspected. Maximum0.914nativepixel residual.
byu-600-12-caps.coordinate_convention: Integer native pixels occupy[y,y+1); baseline anchors use lower ink edges,last black pixel row+1. Column_bottoms retain raw row indices. This adds one pixel to intercept only; slope and residuals unchanged.

broad_S_scale.method: One isotropic fit to eleven non-S capitals after independent seven-serif-foot row rotation. Both S excluded.
